title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1117 | 迷你月亮、红毛吼猴、龟速玩具车
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🌅 地球抓到一颗迷你小月亮，像小手提箱一样大，四月被抓住，十二月就要飞走。
🐒 亚马逊发现两种新吼猴，红毛蓬蓬胡子，吼声能传三英里远。
🚗 两个女孩开玩具车走七百英里，本来要去尼亚加拉瀑布，这周改道去波士顿，已经开了两个月。

📖 Word of the day: orbit（轨道）

🎮 如果开龟速玩具车去波士顿，还是让第二个月亮跟着你回家？跟爸妈一起选！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🌅 Earth caught a mini moon the size of a suitcase in April 2026; it flies away in December.
🐒 Scientists found two new red howler monkey species in the Amazon with howls heard three miles away.
🚗 Two friends are driving toy cars 700 miles from Philadelphia, going 2 mph since October — they just changed the finish line to Boston!

📖 Word of the day: orbit

🎮 Would you rather drive a toy car all the way to Boston or have a tiny second moon follow you home? Friends and parents, pick a side!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. orbit（轨道）
The path something follows around something bigger.
例：The moon is in orbit around Earth.（月亮绕着地球的轨道运行。）

2. howl（嚎叫）
A long loud cry, like a monkey or wolf makes.
例：The howler monkey gave a big howl.（吼猴发出一声大嚎叫。）

3. suitcase（手提箱；行李箱）
A bag for carrying clothes when you travel.
例：The mini moon is the size of a suitcase.（这颗迷你月亮和手提箱一样大。）

4. waterfall（瀑布）
Water falling down from a high place to a lower place.
例：They are driving to Niagara Falls, a big waterfall.（他们要开到尼亚加拉瀑布，一个大瀑布。）
